### Participating projects

This cluster brings together projects 

- [**P02** - Grammatical Gender in Discourse](../subprojects/P02.qmd),
- [**P03** - Mismatches in Binding and Coreference](../subprojects/P03.qmd),
- [**P05** - The Role of Self in Pronominal Reference](../subprojects/P05.qmd),
- [**P07** - Deficiency and Redundancy in Iberoromance Pronominal Systems](../subprojects/P07.qmd),
- [**P08** - Fading Reference - The Pragmaticalization of Pronoun + Verb](../subprojects/P08.qmd),
- [**P09** - Animacy Features and the Flexibility of Pronouns](../subprojects/P09.qmd),
- [**P10** - Deficiency and Redundancy in Expressing Temporal Relations](../subprojects/P10.qmd).

### Description

The Semantics and Discourse Effects cluster focuses on the interaction between grammatical structure, meaning, and discourse-related interpretation. Its activities have included reading groups and an internal workshop held in December 2025, providing a forum for discussion across the relevant subprojects.
